title: Skirmish off Narsapur
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Skirmish off Narsapur", at revision 1381944017, opens: "The skirmish off Narsapur took place on 14 December 1643 at the road off Narsapur in Golconda between two Danish ships and one Bengali ship." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q140570936, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1643 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
